debug.description: Enable verbose debug logging to stdout and/or log file.

lvm_path.description: Colon-separated PATH where LVM2 binaries (e.g., lvm, vgs, pvs) are located.

max_clients.description: Maximum number of concurrent D-Bus client connections allowed.

cmd_timeout.description: Maximum time (in seconds) to wait for LVM commands to complete before timeout.

auto_activation_volume_list.description: List of volume group names (or regex patterns) eligible for automatic activation.

items.description: Volume group name or regex pattern to auto-activate.

dbus_service_name.description: D-Bus service name under which the daemon advertises its interface.

pid_file.description: Path to the PID file used to track the daemon's process ID.

dbus_conf_path.description: Optional custom path to D-Bus system bus configuration file. Leave empty for default.

monitor_vg_metadata.description: Enable real-time monitoring of volume group metadata changes for D-Bus notifications.

excluded_vg.description: List of volume groups to exclude from all D-Bus management operations.

syslog_verbose.description: Enable detailed logging to syslog in addition to standard messages.

log_file.description: Optional absolute path to a dedicated log file. If empty, only syslog is used.

monitor_thin_pool_metadata.description: Enable monitoring of thin pool metadata changes (required for thin-provisioning D-Bus features).
